name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 51% drop in CPL over the last 7 days (driven by a 50% lead volume increase on Meta while overall spend fell 27%), suggesting improved Meta efficiency. However, a significant attribution gap exists: Google Ads shows 13 conversions and GHL CRM shows 40 won opportunities from 521 created, and these figures are unreconciled, so true lead cost and close rate remain unclear.

performance.verdict: CPL drop is real but fragile — 5 overdue SOW gates cap any scale action.

findings.text: CPL fell 51% (7d delta) as Meta generated 50% more leads on lower spend — confirmed efficiency gain, but only 6 GHL-tracked leads in 28 days vs 521 opportunities created; volume base is too thin to trust the CPL signal.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 (overdue 2026-08-31): speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat, blocking scale-up gate per SOW.
5 additional SOW milestones overdue (booking bot battle-test 7/31, Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, LSA heating re-enable 9/1) — none show a completion event.

3-day signal (Sep 9–11): leads = 0, spend avg $52/day — flat to prior 3 days (Sep 6–8: leads = 2, spend avg $78/day). Google spend collapsed 36% over 7d; last 3 days average only $23/day vs $58/day prior 3.

Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP: 189 impressions over 24 days, 0 calls, 0 directions — a 0% call rate with active impressions is a profile-health or category mismatch issue the score flagged but the cause is unresolved.

suggestions.text: Confirm and document new intake owner with GHL login; unblocks scale-up gate and speed-to-lead automations immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake seat has been unconfirmed since 2026-08-31 per SOW. Action: contact Xavier or Nader to name the current intake owner, verify their GHL login, and confirm after-hours coverage. Success check: named owner with active GHL login confirmed in writing by 2026-09-19. Until this is cleared, no budget increases are permitted per the SOW scale-back-up gate.

suggestions.text: Investigate Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profile: 189 impressions, 0 calls — audit category, phone number, and CTA configuration.
suggestions.monday_update: The Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profile recorded 189 impressions across 24 days but zero calls and zero directions in the 28-day window. Action: audit the primary category, verify the phone number matches the tracking number, and confirm the call button is enabled. Success check: call rate moves above 0 (matching Fibid Heating & Air profile's 0.94%) within 14 days of the fix — re-check by 2026-09-26.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL efficiency: if 3-day lead count stays ≥1/day through Sep 15, flag for a ≤20% budget increase — do not act yet.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta produced a 51% CPL drop over 7 days but the last 3 days (Sep 9–11) show 0 leads on ~$52/day spend, which is too thin to confirm the trend holds. Action: monitor daily Meta leads through 2026-09-15 without touching budget. Success check: if daily lead count averages ≥1/day over the next 3 days, bring a ≤20% Meta daily budget increase to Sohib for approval — otherwise hold until the next cycle.
